methods.what: Differential equation with power-series ansatz in odd powers of x
Substitution y = x+z giving a differential equation for z
First-order perturbation in δ: linear ODE for u and its solution by integration
Separation of variables: series for artanh x equated to the integral of the expanded integrand in y
